data.one_liner: Retrieve Android and iOS device user agents and related constants in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to retrieve standard device user agents, WebView user agents, and various system constants for Android and iOS. It helps in constructing custom user agents or identifying the client platform details.
use_when: You need to fetch the native device user agent or WebView user agent.
You require additional system and application constants for custom user-agent building on Android or iOS.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
You do not need user agent information.
strengths: Provides both system and WebView user agents for Android and iOS.
Returns additional useful constants for custom user-agent building.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms.
Documentation does not mention support for desktop or web platforms.
